X1_lodging_tax.claim: The 13.38% rate applies to hotels located inside the Primary Gaming Corridor (PGC); the rate is 13.00% outside it.

sources.publisher: City of Las Vegas, Business License Division
sources.title: Transient Lodging Establishment Room Tax Instructions & Guidelines (Rev. March 2026)
states: Room tax rate INSIDE the Primary Gaming Corridor is 13.38%; OUTSIDE is 13.00% (Collecting and Remitting Room Tax).
Room tax must be shown as a separate charge and may NOT be included in the room price.

Appendix IV disbursement, inside PGC (75+ rooms): LVCVA 6.12%, Nevada Dept. of Taxation 0.38%, City of Las Vegas 1%, Clark County transportation 1%, Clark County education 1%, Stadium District 0.88%, State of Nevada 3%; total 13.38%.
Appendix IV, outside PGC (75+ rooms): LVCVA 6.12%, NDOT 0.38%, City 1%, transportation 1%, education 1%, Stadium District 0.5%, State 3%; total 13%.
Appendix III lists the same totals with a different split (e.g. LVCVA 5.5% + City 2% for 75+ rooms inside PGC); both appendices total 13.38% / 13%.

sources.publisher: Clark County, Department of Business License
sources.title: Newly adopted transient lodging tax rate changes (letter, November 15, 2016)
states: Primary Gaming Corridor: 12.0% (current) + 0.5% (LVCVA expansion) + 0.88% (stadium) = 13.38%, effective March 1, 2017.
Outside the Stadium District and the PGC: only the 0.5% LVCVA increase applies (the letter does not state a total for that area).
sources.caveat: This is the 2016 adoption letter. The March 2026 City packet above is the more recent official statement of the rate.

not_verified: Whether each individual hotel on the board sits inside the PGC. That needs the official PGC map (City packet Appendix II; Clark County Business License site). No hotel has been placed inside or outside the PGC in this session.

Whether the 13.38% applies to the resort fee as well as the room rate. The fee is not stated as taxable or non-taxable in the sources read here. The Venetian resort-fee page says only '$55 plus tax per night'.
Secondary sites (roommaster.com, lodgify.com, legalclarity.org, casino.org, airbnb help) repeat 13.38% / 13% but are not official and are not used as evidence.
